lines.en: I trail my robe across the woodland.

lines.zh: 我一步步迈向空地中央。
lines.en: I stride toward the middle of the clearing.
My wooden staff taps the ground.
I go around an old tree.
I pace back and forth among the trees.
My robe's hem sweeps the leaves.
I walk toward the evokers.

lines.zh: 我走过落叶，没有踩碎一片。
lines.en: I cross the leaves without cracking one.
I move in your direction.
I stop and steady myself.
I stand with my staff raised.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手拿着图腾。
lines.en: My other hand holds a totem.

lines.zh: 林地府邸的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: The mansion's shadow falls on me.
I wait for my spell to ready.
I murmur old words.

lines.zh: 风把长袍吹得贴住身体。
lines.en: Wind presses my robe to my body.
I stand still as an idol.
I raise my head to the moon.
The carvings on my staff glow.
A crow settles in the woods.
I grip the totem tighter.

lines.zh: 我另一只手，握着不死图腾。
lines.en: My other hand holds a totem of undying.
Crows call in the distance.

lines.zh: 我的影子在落叶上不动。
lines.en: My shadow lies still on the leaves.
The totem hangs in my off hand.

lines.zh: 烛火烧到我这一截，已经很久。
lines.en: The candle has burned down to my mark for a long while.

lines.zh: 你踩着的落叶是我的地界。
lines.en: The leaves you stand on mark my ground.
I raise my staff and point at you.
I look you over slowly.
You carry no totem.
My eyes sit beneath the hood.
How long do you wish to live?
I laugh, but you can't hear it.

lines.zh: 你的指节发白，我看见了。
lines.en: Your knuckles have gone white; I see it.
I remember everyone who came.
Try backing away, if you like.
I raise a hand, palm up.
This time, I won't advise you.
A tear has opened in my robe.
That had some force.
I steady myself on my staff.
The totem burns in my hand.
I don't fall so easily.
I raise my staff again.

lines.zh: 你出手的规矩我记住了。
lines.en: I've noted how you strike.
My recitation didn't stop.

lines.zh: 不死图腾裂了，我也跟着疼。
lines.en: The totem cracks, and I ache with it.
We continue.
This totem would serve you better.
What you hold is worth little.
I glance, then look away.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指晃了晃。
lines.en: I wag one finger.

lines.zh: 这东西我不需要，图腾还挂在手上。
lines.en: I do not need this; a totem still hangs from my hand.

lines.zh: 我可以告诉你它值几条命。
lines.en: I could tell you how many lives it's worth.

lines.zh: 你把它举高点，我看清楚。
lines.en: Hold it higher; let me see.
Take it back; keep it to buy your life.
I don't take mortal gifts.
I laugh, very softly.
You brushed my robe.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，石阶响了一声。
lines.en: I step back; the stone stair rings once.

lines.zh: 我的袍角擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My robe hem brushes your shoulder.
My staff lies between us.
No need to crowd; there's room.
My robe's shadow covers your feet.
I didn't mean to touch you.
I slowly adjusted my stance.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞连袍角都没动。
lines.en: That didn't even stir my hem.
We stand on either side; good.

lines.zh: 另一位穿长袍的身影走近。
lines.en: Another robed figure comes near.
Our staffs cross.
The mansion is room enough for us.
She carries a totem too.
We recite the same words together.
Candle flames waver between us.

lines.zh: 烛光把两个影子并在一起。
lines.en: Candlelight joins our two shadows.
This wood will remember tonight.

lines.zh: 两根木杖并在一处，谁也没说话。
lines.en: Two staffs stand side by side, and neither speaks.
At dawn, we part.
I flick it up with my staff.
I look at it and tuck it in my robe.
This isn't worth many lives.

lines.zh: 我手里那个图腾，还没用。
lines.en: The totem in my hand is unused.

lines.zh: 不死图腾握在手里，凉得发沉。
lines.en: The totem in hand is cold and heavy.
I hold it up to the moonlight.
I shake my head and drop it.
Even this I'll take.
I slip it into my sleeve.
I needn't a second look.
I ask you once more.
I've raised my staff.
Good, you open this bout.

lines.zh: 这片落叶上只有你我两个影子。
lines.en: Only our two shadows on these fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 不死图腾在我副手，亮着。
lines.en: The totem in my off hand is glowing.

lines.zh: 我的手心朝上，念词开始。
lines.en: My palm turns up, and the chant begins.
The way behind you is gone.
This mansion is mine.
I begin the words.
You can't hear what I say.

lines.zh: 我再问一次，你想活多久？
lines.en: I ask again: how long do you wish to live?
You don't answer; good.
I raise my hand and the spell rises.
This is when you should run.
I'm in no hurry; there's much time.
Good, I begin the incantation.
You'll remember this night.

lines.zh: 让我看看你的命有多长。
lines.en: Let me see how long your life is.
I walk slowly around you.
My staff draws a line on the ground.
I watch you silently.
You are inside the circle.
I draw another circle.
The entrance here is sealed.
Your steps have gone awry.
I raise a hand and the torches light.
I see you looking for a way out.

lines.zh: 我把最后一道圈画完了。
lines.en: I close the last circle.
I finish the last line.
Did you catch that line?
I add another circle.
In this moment the ground goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我的木杖点在地上，一步一响。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground with every step.
I lift my staff.
You have a last little time.
I keep waiting.
I step across my own circle.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就补一笔。
lines.en: Each time you move, I add a stroke.
One staff blow and the ground splits.
My summoned fangs lunge in.
You're ringed by fire.
One wave and the wind presses down.
The totem in my offhand still glows.
My left hand presses the totem.
A shriek echoes through the wood.

lines.zh: 图腾碎了，我还能站起来。
lines.en: The totem breaks, and I rise again.
You're still standing; stubborn.
I raise the staff to strike again.
Dust settles on my robe.
I withdraw and begin again.
The totem in my hand is still glowing.
I close my palm.

lines.zh: 我从林地府邸的门里走出。
lines.en: I step out of the mansion door.
Mist rises in the wood; I have come.
The Totem King, here.
I advance with my staff raised.
The evokers draw back to either side.
My robe sweeps the stone steps.
Moonlight falls on my hood.
I raise a hand and the torches blaze.
This wood is mine from tonight.
My robe hem comes through the door first.

lines.zh: 我的木杖敲了两下地面。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground twice.
I come bearing a totem of undying.
This place should have changed hands long ago.
I take my stand in the doorway.
My shadow moves in the mist.
Crows circle above me.
I lift my eyes to you.
Your timing is not fortunate.
I raise my staff and point at you.
I stand at the top of the steps.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的袍角，冒出焦烟。
lines.en: Fire catches my hem and smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我从阶上跌下，袍子翻起。
lines.en: I fall from the steps, my robe flaring.

lines.zh: 水没到我的帽檐，我呛住了。
lines.en: Water reaches my hood and I choke.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的木杖震得脱手。
lines.en: The blast knocks the staff from my grip.
An arrow pierces my sleeve.

lines.zh: 两股法术相撞，我的手都麻了。
lines.en: Two spells collide and my hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 太久没用食，我的法术也弱了。
lines.en: Too long without food, and my spells weaken.

lines.zh: 雷劈在府邸顶，我手里的图腾一颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the roof and the totem shudders.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面可以画圈。
lines.en: No ground here to draw a circle on.
